Package com.nexuslink.protocol.redis

Interface RespValue

All Known Implementing Classes:
RespValue.BigNumber, RespValue.BulkError, RespValue.BulkString, RespValue.RespArray, RespValue.RespBoolean, RespValue.RespDouble, RespValue.RespError, RespValue.RespInteger, RespValue.RespMap, RespValue.RespNull, RespValue.RespPush, RespValue.RespSet, RespValue.SimpleString, RespValue.VerbatimString
public sealed interface RespValue permits RespValue.SimpleString, RespValue.RespError, RespValue.RespInteger, RespValue.BulkString, RespValue.RespArray, RespValue.RespNull, RespValue.RespBoolean, RespValue.RespDouble, RespValue.BigNumber, RespValue.BulkError, RespValue.VerbatimString, RespValue.RespMap, RespValue.RespSet, RespValue.RespPush
A decoded RESP (Redis Serialization Protocol) value. Covers the RESP2 wire types plus the common RESP3 additions. Text payloads are UTF-8; RespValue.BulkString keeps raw bytes so it is binary-safe.

This is a closed, typed hierarchy — pattern-match over it to consume replies: 


 RespValue reply = new RespCodec().decode(bytes);
 String s = switch (reply) {
     case RespValue.SimpleString ss -> ss.value();
     case RespValue.BulkString bs   -> bs.asText();
     default                        -> reply.toString();
 };
